text.tspan: Theoretical Test Questions for the Learner’s Licence
Theoretical Test Questions for the Learner’s Licence
Which road marking indicates a pedestrian crossing?
Which road marking indicates there is an escape route ahead?
Decrease in number of lanes ahead
Increase in number of lanes ahead
What do these lane lines indicate?
The lanes within which pedestrians must walk.
Which road marking indicates a kerbface?
Act as for a four way stop
Act as for a four way stop
